III. La ruse

By Harold Greenthal

 
(From the French of Tristan Klingsor, 1921)

O
LD
 K
HALIF
 with the perfumed beard,

You have imprisoned my beloved

In a hundred robes of silk

And scarlet velvet:

But the five little white mice
        5

That are her fingers

Know how to deliver quickly

Her flower-fleshed body,

While the eunuch at the door

Sleeps like a heron on one foot.
        10
